citations.label: Fla. Stat. § 83.49(3)
citations.quote: the landlord must return the security deposit, together with interest if otherwise required, within 15 days after the termination of the rental agreement

findings.clause_text: The Landlord will return the security deposit within 45 days after the Tenant moves out.
findings.title: The deposit comes back later than the law allows
findings.why: The clause gives the landlord 45 days to return the deposit. Florida law requires its return within 15 days after the rental agreement ends when the landlord makes no claim on it, and the statute prevails over the lease.

article.heading: Deposit money or advance rent; duty of landlord and tenant
article.label: Fla. Stat. § 83.49
article.text:
(1) Whenever money is deposited or advanced by a tenant …
(3) The landlord or the landlord’s agent may disburse advance rents from the deposit account to the landlord’s benefit when the advance rental period commences and without notice to the tenant. For all other deposits:
(a) Upon the vacating of the premises for termination of the rental agreement, if the landlord does not intend to impose a claim on the security deposit, the landlord must return the security deposit, together with interest if otherwise required, within 15 days after the termination of the rental agreement.

source.title: Florida Statutes 2026, chapter 83 (Landlord and Tenant), part II
